text.autoconfig.simplevault.title: Simple Vault
text.autoconfig.simplevault.option.vault: A rare gap in the Overworld bedrock leads into the Bedrock Vault: quiet halls below the bedrock, enclosed by bedrock, a way out only through its riddles. Off: no new gaps, existing gates do nothing. Default: on.
One in this many new Overworld chunks (0-100000, 0 = none) gets a 2 x 2 gap through the bedrock floor with the Vault Gate at its bottom. Default: 400.
Seconds after the first entry until the inner gate seals behind the players (5-600). Until then it leads back out; once nobody is inside it opens again. Default: 30.
Volume of the quiet, random sounds in the Bedrock Vault in percent (0-100, 0 = silent); a drip or a far chime every 30-90 s. The Ambient slider applies too. Default: 40.
item.simplevault.seal_fragment.tooltip: Fits only the altar of its own vault
message.simplevault.vault.arrive: The Bedrock Vault - three seals open the ascent. The gate closes in %s s
message.simplevault.vault.sealed: The gate is sealed - someone is inside the vault
message.simplevault.vault.closed: The gate behind you has closed. The way out is the Ascent Altar
message.simplevault.vault.left: You stepped back out through the gate
message.simplevault.vault.ascended: The stream carries you up into the open
message.simplevault.vault.held: The vault's bedrock holds (Vault-bound). The way out is the Ascent Altar
message.simplevault.vault.lamps: %s of %s lamps match the mural above
message.simplevault.vault.chime_fade: The sound fades - start again with the frieze's first tone
message.simplevault.vault.path_start: The path starts at one of the two ends of the field
message.simplevault.vault.path_fade: The path goes dark - follow the light on the ceiling
message.simplevault.vault.solved.light: The lamps match - the Seal Part of Light lies ready
message.simplevault.vault.solved.sound: The frieze rings - the Seal Part of Sound lies ready
message.simplevault.vault.solved.path: The path glows - the Seal Part of the Path lies ready
message.simplevault.vault.hint.light: Set the levers so the lamps show the mural above them
message.simplevault.vault.hint.sound: Strike the crystals in the order of the frieze, left to right
message.simplevault.vault.hint.path: Cross the tiles along the lichen on the ceiling
message.simplevault.vault.took.light: Seal Part of Light - set it into the yellow socket of the altar
message.simplevault.vault.took.sound: Seal Part of Sound - set it into the violet socket of the altar
message.simplevault.vault.took.path: Seal Part of the Path - set it into the green socket of the altar
message.simplevault.vault.already_set: This seal is already in the altar
message.simplevault.vault.carrying: You already carry this seal part
message.simplevault.vault.wrong_part: This seal part does not fit here
message.simplevault.vault.socket.light: The yellow socket waits for the Seal Part of Light
message.simplevault.vault.socket.sound: The violet socket waits for the Seal Part of Sound
message.simplevault.vault.socket.path: The green socket waits for the Seal Part of the Path
message.simplevault.vault.ascent_open: The seal in the dome gives way - step onto the altar and rise
